scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:93 definitions updated and7 retained. Recover native aura/Arcane wrappers, spell-trigger dispatch, ETB/query/timing/legend/haste gates, characteristic P/T, mana workers, token colors and single ANYBODY mass actions. Twelve abstract/specialized contracts preserve full original source interfaces for chroma, affinity and inspired and existing private cycling/replicate forms. Aligned assembly confirms stack test fields. Existing helper names and private callbacks retained, with declarations moved/added before use. Independent callees/gameplay remain separately tracked; no whole-program or generated-byte equivalence claim.
